hypothesis: Integer-cell keyed prefetch plus sorted in-physics-tick activation yields identical activation ticks and telemetry across pre-pinned and streamed worker counts.
limitations: This is a deterministic proxy, not a RigidBody3D vehicle streaming scene.
It proves activation scheduling and telemetry invariance under out-of-order ready completion.
Production still needs the same check with real HeightMapShape3D resources and raycast/suspension contact.
production_recommendation: Carry this into a Godot S3 implementation by building immutable shape data off-thread, then activating bodies only from _physics_process in sorted cell order with a bounded per-tick activation cap. Keep the prefetch budget from S2 and record activation ticks.
